svg.aria-label: SysML v2 general view of the Stronghold proof. A Page holds one or more host web parts and exactly one app; every host connects through its conjugated StrongholdApp port to the app's StrongholdApp port, by the interface mount. ServerHost, OnlineHost and DevHost specialize Host, so each carries the shared loader and that port. StrongholdApp, HostServices, AppHandle, HTMLElement and Loader sit in the package HostFiles, the code every host compiles.
